openings: We write on behalf of {{first}} to record the terms on which it and {{second}} have agreed to settle the dispute over unpaid invoices for the 2026 logistics services.
Once you countersign this letter, it is a binding agreement in full and final settlement of all claims between our clients arising from those invoices.
This letter sets out the terms agreed between {{first}} and {{second}} to settle the claim issued in the High Court concerning the delayed delivery of packaging machinery.
The parties settle the claim without any admission of liability.

sections.heading: Settlement Sum
variants: {{secondShort}} shall pay {{firstShort}} GBP 212,500 within fourteen days of the date of this letter, in full and final settlement.
The sum of GBP 96,000 shall be paid in two equal instalments, on 15 January and 15 February 2027.

sections.heading: Release
variants: On receipt of the settlement sum, each party releases the other from all claims arising from the matters in dispute, whether known or unknown.
Each party waives any further claim relating to the machinery, and shall bear its own legal costs.

sections.heading: Proceedings
variants: Within seven days of payment, the parties shall file a consent order staying the proceedings on the terms of this letter.
The claimant shall discontinue the claim within five working days of receiving the final instalment.
